flashcard_questions.q: Any thought or action that goes against God's will and separates humans from God.
The idea that all humans are born with a built-in tendency to sin, inherited from Adam and Eve's disobedience in the Garden of Eden.
Being saved from sin and its consequences; being granted eternal life with God.

flashcard_questions.a: The Fall — it broke the perfect relationship between God and humanity.
flashcard_questions.q: What do Christians call Adam and Eve's disobedience in Eden?

flashcard_questions.a: The free, undeserved gift of God's love and favour; Christians believe grace is given freely and cannot be earned.
